episodes.title: Gotta have Faith
episodes.summary: Devout mother Babalwa is thrust into an impossible situation as her daughter's health takes a turn for the worse, forcing her to enter a Faustian pact.

episodes.title: The Inside Woman
episodes.summary: Babalwa's failed heist attempt draws unwelcome attention from a corrupt lawman. Zweli's show of initiative puts him at odds with Baba G.

episodes.title: Saints And Sinners
episodes.summary: Babalwa's scramble to cover her tracks gives rise to a blackmail attempt. Zweli, now in her debt, helps her assemble an unlikely crew for a new heist.

episodes.title: Sodom And Gomora
episodes.summary: As Babalwa and her motley crew plan their heist, they realize they'll need to steal the equipment they require for the job from cops and criminals alike.

episodes.title: Judas Iscariot
episodes.summary: When Kat violently interrogates Zweli, Babalwa exploits a weakness to get him off their tail. As the heist day draws closer, Lungile grows suspicious.

episodes.title: Iron Watch
episodes.summary: A disgraced Kat gatecrashes a fundraiser for Palesa. As the heist begins, a combination of unforeseen events threatens to plunge the job into chaos.
